description: US-pinned inference through Claude Platform on AWS, an Anthropic-operated Claude API offer authenticated and billed through AWS. This is not Amazon Bedrock: Phaseo sends inference_geo=us to keep supported model inference in US data centers.
residency_notes: US-only inference offer for Claude Platform on AWS. Phaseo sends inference_geo=us on every request; Anthropic documents that this keeps model inference within US data centers on Claude 4.6 and later. The AWS workspace region scopes the gateway, IAM, CloudTrail, and billing resources but does not determine inference geography. Anthropic operates the inference stack, processes prompts and outputs outside the AWS security boundary, and does not document a separate storage-residency guarantee for this offer.
prompt_training_notes: Anthropic says customer API data is not used to train its models by default.
user_identifier_notes: Phaseo does not currently send this provider a provider-facing user identifier in the Anthropic chat adapter.
regional_pricing_notes: US-only inference on Claude Platform on AWS is priced at 1.1x the standard rate across input, output, cache-write, and cache-read tokens on Claude 4.6 and later models. AWS Marketplace invoices the resulting usage as Claude Consumption Units.

sources.notes: Anthropic-operated architecture, regional gateway host, Claude API routes and model IDs, AWS authentication and billing, model availability, US inference pinning, and retention caveats.
inference_geo=us behavior, Claude 4.6+ eligibility, workspace geography limits, and 1.1x US-only pricing.
Claude Platform on AWS CCU billing and US inference pricing across all token categories.

verification.notes: Verified as the Phaseo regional routing variant of Claude Platform on AWS. It uses the same regional AWS gateway and POST /v1/messages route as anthropic-aws, with inference_geo forced to us; it is distinct from Amazon Bedrock.
